item.title: Frankfort Independent closed for remainder of week due to extreme illness
item.description: Frankfort Independent announced on Tuesday that the district will not return to in-person learning until Monday due to the number of illnesses impacting students and stuff.

item.title: Reflecting on Reverend Jesse Jackson's legacy
item.description: Rev. Jesse Jackson's ability to give underrepresented groups a voice remains one of his most celebrated qualities, according to the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People.

item.title: Despite Oweh's 28 points, UK falls 86-78 against Georgia
item.description: Kentucky returned home to Rupp Arena and lost to Georgia 86-78. The Bulldogs first win in Rupp Arena since March of 2009.
